person.description: a human being, as this graph knows them

persona.description: a voice an agent wears: the doc beside it IS the voice

state.description: running, stopped, paused, disabled, retired, or held

surface.description: native: it runs here. managed: something else runs it

role.description: a persona hired into standing work: what it is responsible for, and whether it is running. When it wakes is a @yaks/wake `wake` pointed at it, where it works is a @yaks/git `worktree`, and what it last decided is kernel `decided`

persona_read.title: Read a persona
persona_read.description: A persona as one markdown document: its own voice, then every doc it carries in full, then a line naming each doc it only reads. This is the text an agent is handed to wear — where it lands (a file, a repo, a spawn's system prompt) is the caller's business.

persona.description: the persona's eid, its id, or the name it answers to
